notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Doors can now be opened and closed by player
Player can now scroll through all weapons and items with mouse wheel
Customizable key binding
Inverted mouse
Expanded graphics settings
Fixed FPS issue upon death causing players to respawn instantly
Altered volumes of certain audio
Implemented guide 
Fixed item/weapon collision

Included Unreal error reporter: Should provide additional data for users experiencing crashes, so feel free to post details here or in a new discussion.
